properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 9 at 3:09PM CDT until September 10 at 3:15PM CDT by NWS Des Moines IA
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Iowa...

Raccoon River at Des Moines Fleur Dr affecting Polk County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Raccoon River at Des Moines Fleur Dr, or from Walnut Creek
to the Des Moines River.

* WHEN...Until Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 13.3 feet, SW 30th St is closed from George Flagg
Parkway to Bell Ave. George Flagg Parkway is closed from SW 30th St
to SW 28th St.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 2:47 PM CDT Wednesday the stage was 12.2 feet, and rising.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 13.0 feet
this evening. It will then fall below flood stage late tomorrow
morning.
- Flood stage is 12.0 feet.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

For the latest stream observations and forecasts refer to
weather.gov/desmoines/water.

River forecasts include observed precipitation plus forecast
precipitation over the next 24 hours.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 9 at 6:59PM CDT until September 9 at 7:15PM CDT by NWS Kansas City/Pleasant Hill MO
properties.description:
At 659 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Calhoun, or 7
miles northeast of Clinton, moving east at 40 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Clinton, Windsor, Leeton, Calhoun, Coal, Brownington, Tightwad, Post
Oak, Hartwell, and Truman Lake.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued September 9 at 7:29PM EDT until September 9 at 9:30PM EDT by NWS Tallahassee FL
properties.description:
SMWTAE

The National Weather Service in Tallahassee has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Apalachee Bay or Coastal Waters From Keaton Beach to Ochlockonee
River Fl out to 20 Nm...
Coastal waters from  Suwannee River to Keaton Beach out 20 NM...

* Until 930 PM EDT.

* At 729 PM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located 19 nm north of
Suwannee River, moving west at 15 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots...suddenly higher
waves...frequent lightning...and heavy downpours. Make
sure all on board are wearing life jackets.

* Locations impacted include...
Horseshoe Beach.
properties.instruction: Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 9 at 7:33PM EDT until September 9 at 8:15PM EDT by NWS State College PA
properties.description:
SVRCTP

The National Weather Service in State College has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Central Tioga County in north central Pennsylvania...

* Until 815 PM EDT.

* At 733 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Gaines, or 13
miles west of Wellsboro, moving east at 35 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Mansfield, Wellsboro, Westfield, Gaines, Covington, Keeneyville,
Tioga and Mansfield University.

This includes Interstate 99 between mile markers 175 and 192.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds.

Tornadoes can develop quickly from severe thunderstorms. Seek shelter
immediately in an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built
structure.
